actions.mechanism: Separate intake from opening authorization so uncertain item classification never grants general volunteers electrical access.
actions.implementation: Add an electrical-or-uncertain flag and specialist authorization field. General volunteers record owner-reported symptoms without opening flagged equipment; only the specialist opens electrical equipment.
actions.check: Audit observed openings against operator names; any electrical opening by a general volunteer fails the check.
actions.risk: Misclassification can bypass the gate; route uncertainty to the specialist.

actions.mechanism: A diagnostic checkpoint forces a continuation decision without assuming every repair can safely stop immediately.
actions.implementation: Set a 15-minute initial diagnostic review. At review, record continue, safely pause, await parts, or return, with an accountable person and next action.
actions.check: Every diagnosis exceeding 15 minutes must have a recorded decision; track overruns lacking one.
actions.risk: Unsafe interruption; the specialist controls pausing opened electrical equipment.

actions.action: Protect turns for short safe jobs
actions.mechanism: A rotating dispatch rule prevents uncertain repairs from consuming every newly available bench turn.
actions.implementation: Alternate available bench starts between assessed short safe jobs and the oldest other ready item. Use either queue when the other is empty.
actions.check: With both queues populated, two consecutive starts from one queue violate the rule. Record specialist-unavailable exceptions separately.
actions.risk: Short-job estimates can be wrong; apply diagnostic checkpoints after starting.

actions.action: Move parts waits out of active work
actions.mechanism: A separate parts-wait state prevents unavailable components from silently occupying the ready queue or a bench.
actions.implementation: After safe stabilization, move blocked items to labeled existing storage. Record required part, procurement responsibility, and review date; return to ready only after verification.
actions.check: At closing, every parts-wait item has a storage location and procurement owner, and none is counted as active.
actions.risk: Without suitable storage, arrange owner collection rather than unsafe parking.

actions.action: Maintain item custody independently of repair status
actions.mechanism: A stable identifier links owner receipt, physical location, and custody even when an item changes workflow state.
actions.implementation: Issue matching numbered item tags and owner receipts. Maintain a location register; record every move, including separately stored components, before releasing custody.
actions.check: Sample five receipts each shift: locate each item and its components, then match their tags back to the owner record.
actions.risk: Detached tags break traceability; secure labels without damaging items.

actions.action: Require accepted responsibility at shift handoff
actions.mechanism: Explicit acceptance transfers accountability rather than leaving unfinished work assigned to someone who has departed.
actions.implementation: For every retained item, record state, location, last finding, next action, and responsible person. Incoming volunteers acknowledge assignments; electrical opening remains specialist-only.
actions.check: After handoff, no retained item lacks an accepting responsible person or a concrete next action.
actions.risk: If nobody accepts, the shift lead retains coordination responsibility.

actions.action: Communicate uncertainty instead of single deadlines
actions.mechanism: Separate the next status update from completion expectations so diagnosis and parts uncertainty remain visible.
actions.implementation: Use receipt fields for next update date and completion estimate. Permit either 'unknown' or an explicit time range with assumptions; prohibit standalone completion dates.
actions.check: Audit receipts and visitor messages: every completion promise includes a range, and update appointments are not presented as completion promises.
actions.risk: Unsupported ranges mislead; leave completion unknown when evidence is insufficient.

actions.action: Limit retained work to traceable safe spaces
actions.mechanism: A storage-based admission limit prevents parked repairs from overwhelming custody tracking or displacing active bench work.
actions.implementation: Count suitable existing storage positions and assign identifiers. Accept a drop-off only against an available position; otherwise offer owner retention and a later intake opportunity.
actions.check: At shift end, retained-item records reconcile with occupied positions; no item uses an aisle or unrecorded overflow location.
actions.risk: Owner retention may inconvenience visitors; explain the limit before acceptance.
